chunks: And he, peace be upon him, ruled that the protected area of a well is forty cubits; no other well is to be dug beside it for a watering place or for sheep.

key_terms.أَرْبَعُونَ: the specified measure of the protected limit
key_terms.الْبِئْرَ: the well that is the subject of the ruling
key_terms.بِئْرٌ أُخْرَى: another well whose excavation is restricted nearby
key_terms.حَرِيمُهَا: its protected surrounding zone or reserved boundary
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: cubits, the unit used to define the legal distance
key_terms.لَا يُحْفَرُ: it is not to be dug, indicating prohibition
key_terms.لِمَعْطَنٍ: for a watering place for animals

ai.seo_question: What is the protected boundary around a well in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the protected boundary of a well, setting it at forty cubits. It forbids digging another well beside it for livestock watering or sheep, indicating recognized usage rights and regulated access to water resources.
